name: 洪媽益
objective:
本科目旨在探討現實世界裡語言和溝通的種種現象，如：社會中之語言變化、大眾媒體的語言使用等，並介紹應用語言學門之緣起和現況。學生將需要分享自己對於本地或國際有關語言應用議題的觀察，例如：職場溝通模式、辨識性言詞分析、語言教學/測試趨勢、口筆翻譯項目、語言在新型媒體中之應用等。
This course aims to explore a variety of phenomena in language and communication in the real world, e.g., language variations in societies, language in the mass media, etc. It will also provide an overview of the historical background and the existing profile of applied linguistics as an academic discipline. Students are expected to share their own observations on AL-related issues, e.g., workplace communication modes, critical discourse analysis, language instruction/testing trends, translation/ interpretation projects, language use in the new forms of media, etc., in the local or international context.
課程進度(1-16週):
W1 September 10/11, Orientation and Ch17 Applications
W2 September 17/18, Ch 7 Pragmatics
W3 September 24, Ch 7 Pragmatics
W4 October 1/2, Ch 16 Computers and Linguistics
W5 October 8, Corpus Linguistics and Lexico-grammar
W6 October 15/16, MIDTERM EXAM and Language Acquisition
W7 October 22/23, Ch 8 Language Acquisition
W8 October 29/30, Ch 8 Language Acquisition 
W9 November 5/6, Ch 8 Language Acquisition and Psycholinguistics
W10 November 12/13, Ch 9 Psycholinguistics
W11 November 19/20, Ch 9 Psycholinguistics and MIDTERM EXAM
W12 November 26/27, Ch 11 Language and Culture
W13 December 1/3/4, Ch 10/13 Sociolinguistics: Linguistic Factors/Social Factors/Language Change
W14 make-up classes in the previous week
W15 December 17/18, Ch 12 Sociolinguistics Oral presentations
W16 December 24, FINAL EXAM
W17 December 31, Group work on Applied Linguistics-related research methodology
W18 January 7/8, Presentations on Applied Linguistics-related research methodology
END
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Students will find a journal article that interests them, read it and answer the following questions:
1. What is the topic of the article?
2. What are the questions to be answered?
3. What is the background knowledge needed?
4. Use a flowchart to summarize the Methodology used.
5. How differently would you design your own Methodology?
6. What other questions related to the issue need further research?
Print out and submit the report with a copy of the cover page (first page)
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          This activity will enable students to see the importance of equipping themselves with linguistics skills / knowledge and to see actual examples of how linguistics can be actually applied in daily life and in the work place.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          The final paper will account for 20% of the overall grade.

name: 張詠翔
objective:
本堂課會探討幾個語言學子領域以及跨語言學、行為科學和社會科學之基礎課題：語言習得、社會語言學、心理語言學、計算機語言學等。學生將學習以實驗性的方法搜集資料、來探討他們選擇的語言現象。
本堂課理論實務介紹會穿插著學生實體或線上實驗、練習操作。

This course will explore a variety of disciplines within linguistics as well as some cross-interdisciplinary linguistic domains. Students will learn to use experimental methods to collect data to investigate the language phenomenon of their choice. Class lectures will be intertwined with hands-on experiments (online or offline) and activities during the 3-hour meeting.
